name: Honor X70 Refresh Edition
highlights:
Released 2026, April
193g or 199g, 7.8mm thickness
Android 16, MagicOS 10
256GB/512GB storage, no card slot

BODY:
IP68/IP69K dust tight and water resistant (high pressure water jets; immersible up to 6m)
Drop resistant up to 2.5m

DISPLAY.Type: AMOLED, 1B colors, 120Hz, 3840Hz PWM, HDR, 800 nits (typ), 1800 nits (HBM), 6000 nits (peak)

PLATFORM.CPU: Octa-core (1x2.3 GHz Cortex-A720s & 3x2.2 GHz Cortex-A720s & 4x1.8 GHz Cortex-A520s)

COMMS.Bluetooth: 5.2, A2DP, LE, aptX HD, aptX Adaptive, ASHA
COMMS.Positioning: GPS (L1+L5), BDS (B1I+B1c+B2a), GALILEO (E1+E5a), QZSS (L1+L5), NavIC (L5), GLONASS

FEATURES.Sensors: Fingerprint (under display, optical), accelerometer, compass, gyro, proximity (ultrasound)

BATTERY.Charging:
80W wired
80W wireless (512GB model only)
Reverse wireless (512GB model only)
5W reverse wired

MISC.Colors: Sunrise Gold, Vermilion Red, Bamboo Green, Moonlight White, Phantom Black
